name: Jaxon Cover
summary: Learned the game on roller hockey at King's Sports Centre from about age 3 to 12. 2016 NARCh MVP in two age groups. First Caymanian drafted to the NHL — Ottawa Senators, 32nd overall in 2026.

name: Ryder Cali
summary: Played roller hockey in Cayman alongside Cover. Selected by the Florida Panthers in the second round of the 2026 NHL Draft.

name: Jaeden Cover
summary: Jaxon's brother; same youth program at King's before continuing development in Canada.
